How to Brew the Perfect Cup of Black Tea:
Materials needed: Tea leaves (select OP-grade loose leaf, not tea bags), soft water (no mineral water), fresh pasteurized milk, a bit of white sugar, and an elegant tea set.
Steps: 1. Boil water, bring the soft water to a boil
2. Warm the pot for one minute
3. Ration the tea leaves (one teaspoon of tea leaves per cup)
4. Steep the tea leaves for three minutes
5. It's best to drink tea from ceramic cups
6. Add the milk to the cup first, then slowly pour in the tea
7. Add sugar according to personal preference
8. The best drinking temperature is between 60–65 degrees Celsius

Their bodies cannot move and their consciousness falls silent, as if trapped within a single frozen frame. Cheese is a one-time-use Anomaly that immediately disappears after use. Ordinary people are severely affected by Cheese, with freeze duration lasting up to dozens of hours, and they completely lose their memory afterward, only vaguely recalling a blinding flash. Some Espers are only frozen for a few minutes and can clearly recall all details before the shot, including the identity of the camera holder. 作为近几年最出名的邪道漫画「公爵K」的忠实粉丝，安魂曲自然常驻「呗果」，时刻关注:
As a devoted fan of the most famous cult manga "Duke K" in recent years, Lacrimosa naturally hangs out on Bagel, constantly keeping up with the latest news.
Typing is too hard, so Lacrimosa usually just lurks without commenting. She's even too lazy to come up with a username, so she goes online using her real name. Unexpectedly, she was caught by a fellow "Duke K" fanatic called "GeneSectParanormalDeptAce" because of her frequent likes, and somewhat reluctantly gained a friend with shared interests.
Her teammates are quite relieved that Lacrimosa has finally made a friend, but she still can't remember the other person's full username and usually just calls them "Net Friend With A Long Name." On the other hand, the other person apparently still thinks her habit of referring to herself in-person by her online username is rather self-centered…
在古老的部落开始争夺财宝和领地的时期，「玛门」就诞生在了世间。该异象的本体是一只: Mammon came into existence long ago, when ancient tribes first began fighting over treasure and territory. The Anomaly's true form is that of a massive black beast, yet it chooses to appear before people as a black cat with golden eyes, adorned with lavish jewelry. It is a omen of desire, with a keen nose that can sniff out the scent of greed. This elegant black cat prowls near wars sparked by avarice, seizing desires to satisfy its bottomless appetite. Besides desire, Mammon also loves to devour money. After all, for thousands of years, humanity has never given up its pursuit and possession of wealth, so the greed attached to coin is often the richest and purest.
尴尬的年纪，尴尬的身高。她比同龄人唐突高出那么大一截，总能被不知情者误认为是大上:
An awkward age, an awkward height. She towered so much over her peers that strangers would mistake her for a high school student several years older. It wasn't too surprising that Mint, as such a "big kid," couldn't really play with her little friends.
Mint liked climbing trees to nap in the sun, a blade of grass between her teeth as she secretly watched the neighbor kids play and fight. Then, casually… or at least trying to make it look casual, she'd help get their kites unstuck from the branches.
"Tiny" suddenly appeared during one of her half-asleep moments, and Mint still remembers how embarrassing she looked tumbling out of that tree.
The young-faced little guy called out to her: "Hey, kid."

Perhaps it's the price of her Esper Abilities, but aside from tomato products, Lacrimosa can't taste anything she eats. No matter how delicious food smells, eating it is like chewing soft, chewy, or crispy plain cardboard.
The upside is that even when Mint has a "brilliant idea" and creates something like banana coco pumpkin pie, so long as it doesn't smell too questionable, Lacrimosa can eat it all with a straight face!
Rumor has it that the tomato product brand "Tomato 100" once approached Lacrimosa, hoping to invite her to become their spokesperson. However, the collaboration was temporarily suspended due to negative social impact caused by the "Tomato Devil" Anomaly. Recently though, the brand seems interested in restarting the partnership… but we'll leave that story for another time.

Fadia taught herself to manipulate pain as easily as dealing with those money and power-obsessed fools.
She scratches herself, then spreads the pain throughout her body, seeking some kind of balance… the force controlled just right. In this, she has found an addictive calm.
Most people lack the ability to connect emotionally, throwing themselves into things that are easy to focus on and get addicted to. Alternating between extreme pain and pleasure… that's the secret that makes it impossible to stop.
She pities those people, just like she pities herself.

Peepy is obsessed with observing the minutiae of human life: steam rising from breakfast stalls, lovers' hesitant fingertips under streetlights, drunkards mumbling profanities at trash cans… All these vivid moments of life give it a kind of warm, tingling sensation. Life fades away so lightly under his words, like a dream. Is he also a prisoner in that dream? Blindly clinging to the ideal of strength, he was once forced to take life, to repeat this agonizing behavior. He could see his own face reflected in their pupils… Why did that young man bear such a sad, confused expression?
For a long time after, he stopped speaking entirely. Words were curses—he was certain of that.
It wasn't until he met his teacher that he realized that even without Esper Abilities, words still held power. Sometimes, a single short sentence could untangle a person's lifelong demons and troubles.
"Where will the abyss lead? You only know by jumping in."
So he put away his fear and jumped into the chasm that exists between curses and prayers.

Ingredients:
3 eggs, 35g corn oil, 40g milk, 50g cake flour, 30g granulated sugar, half a lemon
Instructions:
1. Separate egg whites and yolks into two bowls.
2. In a new bowl, add 35g corn oil and 40g milk, whisk until yogurt-like consistency.
3. Add egg yolks and cake flour, mix until smooth.
4. Take egg whites from refrigerator, add lemon juice, gradually add sugar in three portions and whip thoroughly.
5. Take 1/3 of the meringue and fold into the egg yolk mixture until evenly combined.
6. Pour the mixed cake batter into the meringue bowl and fold until evenly combined.
7. Pour cake batter into mold, use a toothpick to pop surface bubbles.
8. Bake in oven at 150°C for 60 minutes.

If she left from Hethereau, she would have to take a very, very long boat ride to reach a new city, then transfer to a train and ride for a very, very long time to yet another city… If she chose to fly partway, she would have to take a very, very long bus ride… But even once she's figured out the route home, she has to think about the travel costs, and the savings needed so her family could live happily together without ever having to hunt Apocha again. The Tsukinoki family's courtyard pairs perfectly with fallen snow. The snow gives it an added sense of historical elegance, like covering displayed antiques with a blanket of dust—except this dust is pure white and pristine.
Unfortunately, year after year, such scenery passes by in the blink of an eye. Hotori has always felt this way.
Even at a young age, she was already deeply melancholic about the changing seasons and passing years. This was because she feared that the ever-changing outside world would bring unwanted changes to this reclusive family. How wonderful it would be if everything could freeze like a still life at its most perfect moment.
"The best time to appreciate snow is when it's melting. For that… you need to be in motion, don't you?"
Many years later, when she truly could make snowy scenes stand still, one early spring she encountered—not by chance—an old guest who had once stayed at their family estate for a time. Now an elderly man in his twilight years, he took a sip from his wine cup after every sentence during their casual conversation.
Hotori realized this would be their final meeting. She poured the wine and waited with rare solemnity to hear his next heartfelt words.
"What's most precious isn't what remains unchanged and eternal. It's the things that break… the things that are breaking right now."

A rose faded almost to pale gray, personally presented by a client as a token of sincerity, though beneath its petals lay a web of carefully crafted lies…

Standing on the bustling street corner, Edgar had no idea where he was supposed to go. Though he thought for a long, long time, he remained just as lost, just as confused.
He gave up on route planning, maps, and navigation. Following his mother's advice, he was now "letting the wind guide him" through Hethereau. According to her, encounters with destiny often arrive when you least expect them.
With no destination and no clue which direction to take, could he really find his "destiny" this way? Edgar couldn't fathom such an unplanned approach; the indecision paralyzed him. Instead, he bought a small bag of feed from a street vendor and crouched by the fountain to feed the pigeons.

Later, when Edgar looked back on that day, he felt he'd begun to dimly understand what his mother meant by "fate."
As he felt the pigeons pecking at his palm, watching the sky gradually turn a warm orange as golden clouds drifted toward the still-blue horizon, a sudden gust of wind smacked him right in the face. Along with it came a recruitment poster with crooked handwriting and a drawing of some TV-headed creature.

"Eibon Antique Shop."
He stood up, looked around, and followed the street signs to Hankaku Street.

After retiring from her previous job, Jiuyuan settled into a fairly relaxed life at Sterry.
The day-to-day tasks aren't complicated: sending and receiving packages, checking receipts, and passing around clipboards for signatures… As long as the process is clear and the staff reliable, none of the tasks pose much of a challenge. The real headaches come from commissions that can't be handled through any standard procedures: those involving intel, Anomalies, and the Anomaly Hunters who handle them. Clients with hidden agendas tapping their fingers on the counter, buyers using Anomalies as cover for covert handoffs, clients falsifying danger levels to drag Sterry into their schemes, not to mention the tangled web of factions at play… These may not seem a big deal, yet calculated troubles are far more vexing than any package delivery.

Still, Jiuyuan handles them all with ease.
One moment she's making small talk with a contact at a banquet hall, and the next she's at the scene of a target's transaction, tidying up the mess. She never breaks a sweat, and leaves only the cool scent of roses in her wake. With her intel and finesse, she has quietly woven a web across the fabric of this city. Most ripples, no matter how faint, inevitably land in it.

Though, what she excels at most is reading people.
Hathor, earnest to the point of stubbornness, is assigned to critical operations, handling high-risk Anomalies or missions where failure isn't an option.
Haniel and Illica, lively and quick on their feet, are better suited for dealing with people or coming up with a spark of brilliance when situations go sideways.
As for Manager Jenson and what he's been up to lately…
He really should find a better hiding spot for that fishing rod.

In Sterry's early days, there were only three people. Though few in number, they had clear divisions of labor. The Mentor, well-versed in human weaknesses, frequently moved in social circles, while Jenson, with his proper speech and meticulous attention to protocol and rules, could break through negotiation deadlocks with just a few words, making him better suited for business cooperation discussions. However, from beginning to end, Hathor always maintained some reservations toward Jenson. Her sharp instincts for danger, honed through long training, whispered warnings that this man wasn't as rule-abiding as he appeared, though the Mentor's good working relationship with him indicated that Jenson could currently be trusted. As for the heavy responsibility of package delivery, it naturally fell to Hathor, who joined last.
Sterry's Elite Courier, the tough biker chick of few words, first choice for urgent delivery quests. Regular items, fragile goods, anomaly packages—all reached their destinations accurately, safely, and intact to the roar of her motorcycle. Some statistics claimed that her single-day record was 200 regular deliveries and 11 anomaly containers, all completed while assisting as an Anomaly Hunter contain two Class III anomalies. She was truly a tireless delivery machine: cold, ruthless, efficient.
Hathor herself hadn't noticed that such a pace was too demanding and had gone on too long. It wasn't until she returned one day to the shop, seeing her Mentor smiling and introducing Sterry's new members, that Hathor truly realized how exhuasted from work she was.

"Shinku!"
"Found ya! I knew you'd be here!"
"Look what I found! Tada! Here! Doesn't this remind you of someone who's curled up into a ball crying?"
"That's… not true."

"Doesn't every evil dragon in a story have their own stash of treasures? That dragon who loves picking fights with everyone should have some too! Starting with that shell with the sad little face on it, Shinku began her "treasure hunt."

At first, Linko desperately sought friends.
The flocks of pigeons at dawn, the comets at midnight, the ducks by the river, the shells on the beach, the interesting little shop her mother found, the new game her father recommended—and all those countless frequencies from the infinite beyond reaching into her little head… Linko wished to speak about it to a true friend.
Despite this, she was always alone. Maybe because of her parents, Linko was more tolerant and curious than other kids her age. Whether it was Anomalies, insects, ghost stories, or urban legends, Linko was always full of curiosity. After her Esper Ability awakened, her ability to sense frequencies made the way she perceived the world around her unlike anyone else. Because of that, she had a very difficult time making friends. Even when she joined after-school group activities, she would just stand quietly in the corner.
"Everyone has their own channel. If I try tuning in to their frequency first… could I become friends with them?"
After her Esper Ability awakened, Linko could receive and discern other people's frequencies. If she spent some time tuning to the same frequency as someone else, she could even begin to experience that person's emotions… Were such a thing to come to pass, as long as she kept paying attention to how they felt, she should slowly but surely figure out what would make them happy. At least, that's what Linko thought.
So, the lonely girl began trying to approach other children her age. She was a little stiff and awkward, but it eventually started to work. At last, though she was merely the quietest little tagalong in the bunch, she had finally found the "friends" she had always wanted.
Anyhow, that was what she believed before the split.

Anomaly Story
When a "Cuddly Bear" is no longer needed by its owner and is cast aside, it has the potential to transform into the Derivative Anomaly "Saddy Teddy."
A Saddy Teddy takes the form of a large, worn—if not damaged—plush bear. Common features include a cape and a weapon. The original discarded doll, the Anomaly "Cuddly Bear," is stuffed into the place its heart would be if the bear was a real creature. The Saddy Teddy is known to collect other abandoned toys that met a similar fate of abandonment, repeatedly tearing open its own heart to stuff them inside.
Children's picture book-like patterns sometimes appear in the area surrounding a Saddy Teddy, and can often serve as an early warning sign of its presence. According to multiple investigations, Saddy Teddies are highly hostile and aggressive towards others. Some unverified reports claim that Saddy Teddies do not attack children.
Although Saddy Teddies are hostile towards people, many eyewitness records show that they are open to cooperation with other Anomalies—to a certain extent.

Characteristics
- Appears as a worn, damaged plush bear;
- Has stitched marks over the heart area;
- Continuously collects discarded toys;
- Highly aggressive.

Anomaly Nexus
Destroy the toy(s) in its heart.

Risk Assessment
Low risk.

Containment Status
The Celaeno Compound currently contains one Saddy Teddy. Guaranteeing this Anomaly is currently prohibited.

There was an Esper who went by the name of Icaria on the Boulder. She was short and had a pair of wings, which saved her when the smuggler's ship sank. She usually enjoys zipping around, often joking that she never grew taller because her feet never touched the ground. Conrak called her "Shorty."
Icaria didn't have any parents. She just had an older brother, who liked to make a big deal about working hard to raise her. The brother, however, never cared about her. That's why Icaria decided to stay on the island, though she was capable of flying home herself.
Icaria died when the crew fought an anomaly known as the Kraken. Her wings were not made from feathers, but from some material that melted in high heat. During the fight, she tried to make the anomaly focus on her, but her wings melted when she flew too high and fell right into the Kraken.

After that, Conrak was frustrated about the limitations of his abilities. He tried to experiment with what kind of shapes his smoke could form. Just before a battle, a bird flew past him. He thought that if he could shape his smoke into a bird, he could take to the sky.
This idea didn't come at a good time: he couldn't apply it to the battle at hand, but it was enough to make him regretful… If only he had thought of it sooner, he could have saved Icaria.
Nonetheless, the idea wouldn't have helped even if he had it earlier.

Before entering Ghroth Island, Chaos was an Anomaly Hunter on a small island, where he went by his old name, Conrak. Eventually, he would abandon the name he received from his parents like a sunken boat in the sea.

Conrak once got into a shipwreck with another 11 crewmates. They found themselves in an ocean isolated from the world.
There was an archipelago in the ocean, which didn't even have internet access. Conrak and his crewmates settled on one of the islands but never stopped wanting to go back. Unfortunately, no islander was willing to leave their home to ferry them across unknown waters, and no outside vessels passed through the islands. The group decided to build a ship and sail home by themselves. They named the ship "the Boulder."
Once they built the Boulder, the group began to save up supplies for their return trip. For two years, the group navigated the Boulder around the islands to transport goods for funds. Since the group members were also Anomaly Hunters, they often took commissions, solving many issues that plagued the islanders. Gradually the "Boulder Hunters" became known local heroes.
In the end, because the group lived peacefully on the islands and was praised as heroes, some of them no longer wished to risk another adventure to return. Only five of them decided to go back.

However, on its return journey, the Boulder went through a storm. Conrak fell into the sea, and his companions weren't able to find him.
Luckily, Conrak fell into the sea near Ghroth Island and was saved by an Undertaker from the Island.
Once he formally joined Ghroth Island, Conrak changed his name to Chaos.

那时的九原，早已不是初醒异能的生手，却仍被森严的等级秩序拦在晋升的最后一关前——:
By that time, Jiuyuan was no longer a novice just awakening to her Esper Abilities. Yet she still stood before the final barrier of a rigid hierarchy: she had to earn a codename that was truly her own.

The trial came swiftly. It was an alley skirmish, accompanied by the kind of betrayal and sellouts that were all too common in the trade. Her squad found themselves caught in a total hunt. The value of their intel, their reputation in the circle, and the enemy's frenzied intent to silence them all drove the entire squad deep into the shadows of the alley. Supplies cut off, forces depleted, the outside world a blur, and the cover of night draped over every disadvantage. What should have been the enemy's perfect cover became the rhythm Jiuyuan knew best.
Her footsteps were near silent, yet she found every enemy with precision through the web woven of gunfire and bodies. A faint glow rippled through the dim air like water, followed by a clear, slender call. Cold and unwavering, piercing straight to the soul. Those who heard it felt their blood run cold in an instant.
Whenever that sound swept past an ear or brushed a shoulder, a flicker of rose-colored light would bloom, then condense into a slender bullet before sinking into the target's body. No explosion, no struggle. The moment it struck, it was as if all sound had been drained away, leaving only silent finality.
When the last note, like a bird's call, faded at the alley's end, the depths fell silent once more.
The surviving squad members leaned against the cold walls, watching the figure emerge from the smoke and darkness, the rhythm that had decided life and death still echoing in their ears.
"That was the only sound you could trust in the night."

Later, the codename field on the mission report was filled in with neat handwriting:
Nightingale.
She sings in the deepest dark. Her voice is the prelude to death, and the dawn for those who survive.

One of the Bureau of Anomaly Control's ETD-4 members, and once a criminal.
As for what crime got her thrown onto the legendary Ghroth Island… nothing too serious. It was just an innocent little gesture that put some people to sleep forever.
"Endless rebirth and reincarnation all lead back to the black hole of nothingness."
Twirling her hair around her finger, she smiled with sparkling eyes.
"I simply followed their wishes, sending those party people to the paradise they'd been craving their whole lives."

As a pardoned prisoner, she isn't treated any differently than any other Squad 4 member.
Except by that dog-faced guy with calm but wary eyes. Maybe because a few months ago they were escort officer and wanted criminal?
Well, overall, she thinks her new job is pretty good. Fighting to her heart's content, letting danger excite her mind, letting pain make her body tremble… violence comes from life's excess. How could anyone not be addicted to tasting it?
She doesn't know why that strange woman brought her back from the island, but whatever. She had nowhere else to go anyway. The place where she once knelt and prayed devoutly, entrusting her faith, has long been sealed off. Anyone who sees that ruined wasteland would laugh! Only a pair of familiar silver eyes still gaze at her, merciful, generous, full of desire… she can feel it.

"Go raise some hell, Fadia. I'm sure you'll find something interesting."
A pretender, a dog, and a brat?
Fadia narrowed her eyes.
Well then… let's find that "something interesting."

天才儿童、传闻中「邻居家的孩子」、「被智慧之神亲吻的少年」。\n\n埃德嘉从「灯:
A child prodigy; the "golden kid;" "the boy kissed by the god of wisdom."

The day Edgar came back from Twinkle School of Espers, aunts, uncles, neighbors, and their children all swarmed in droves to congratulate him, nearly trampling down his family's doorstep. Whether they came out of curiosity to see what made this so-called "neighbor's kid you should learn from" so special, or were reluctant children dragged along by parents demanding they "learn from his example," they all reached the same conclusion:
He really didn't look like anything special.

Meanwhile, Edgar found himself surrounded by adults, completely overwhelmed. He just couldn't keep up with their overlapping chatter. As they talked over each other, Edgar's future became crystal clear in their minds: he'd immediately become a star researcher at Zerogon Laboratory, the rising star of Yggash Court, the new director of the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Pink Paws Bank's job offer was worth considering too. With Edgar's abilities, why would't he become a board member at PPB? Of course, when the time came, he shouldn't forget to give a helping hand to that kid living diagonally across from him whose grades barely scraped by in every subject…

The adults listing out and arranging all these bright futures for him had become completely lost in their own fantasies. It was as if Edgar were their own child, fulfilling all the dreams they, themselves, couldn't…

Edgar looked around helplessly, unable to join any conversation. He was so nervous he pulled his scarf up high, wishing he could hide completely inside it. Luckily, at that very moment, his father squeezed through the crowd and patted his shoulder: "What do you want to be when you grow up, Edgar?"

Encouraged by his father's gaze, Edgar said softly:
"I… I just want to be Edgar."

"Iroi called in sick again? Her paid time off and sick days ran out ages ago. Feels like her paycheck's been getting docked."
"She doesn't seem to care about her paycheck… She once said she wouldn't mind paying to work. It didn't sound like she was joking about it."
"That's so nice. She works pretty hard. I didn't know she was just working to experience the world…"

Iroi has been prone to sickness since childhood. She couldn't attend regular schools. Luckily, her family was well-off, so she had a private tutor all the time, and she became as educated as someone who has done general university coursework.
After finishing her studies, her parents wanted her to integrate into society, but her health couldn't handle the demands of a regular job. Iroi wanted to work at a social welfare organization, so her parents sent her to the Sunward, an anomaly charity house, to volunteer, where she also helped with the simpler anomaly intake work.
Iroi's current personality is deeply shaped by the vibes of the charity house. Before going there, she hadn't had much contact with others. Her tutor and butler were cold and rigid, always overly cautious, while her parents doted on her too much. Iroi understood that not all human beings were like them, so she instinctively chose to blend in with "everyone else."
Life on the island wasn't exactly smooth sailing. Things were a lot tougher than they were back home. Nevertheless, Iroi enjoyed that kind of environment much more, because she felt more alive.
During the Teehee Bear incident at the charity house, Iroi the volunteer provided significant help to the Bureau, and the Bureau staff took notice of this talented Esper. At the same time, Iroi found herself drawn to the Bureau's work. They came to an agreement and Iroi joined the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Given her strong control over her powers, she was recommended to join CSU-2.
Life has a way of moving on.
天才儿童、传闻中「邻居家的孩子」、「被智慧之神亲吻的少年」。\r\n\r\n埃德:
A child prodigy; the "golden kid;" "the boy kissed by the god of wisdom."

The day Edgar came back from Twinkle School of Espers, aunts, uncles, neighbors, and their children all swarmed in droves to congratulate him, nearly trampling down his family's doorstep. Whether they came out of curiosity to see what made this so-called "neighbor's kid you should learn from" so special, or were reluctant children dragged along by parents demanding they "learn from his example," they all reached the same conclusion:
He really didn't look like anything special.

Meanwhile, Edgar found himself surrounded by adults, completely overwhelmed. He just couldn't keep up with their overlapping chatter. As they talked over each other, Edgar's future became crystal clear in their minds: he'd immediately become a star researcher at Zerogon Laboratory, the rising star of Yggash Court, the new director of the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Pink Paws Bank's job offer was worth considering too. With Edgar's abilities, why would't he become a board member at PPB? Of course, when the time came, he shouldn't forget to give a helping hand to that kid living diagonally across from him whose grades barely scraped by in every subject…

The adults listing out and arranging all these bright futures for him had become completely lost in their own fantasies. It was as if Edgar were their own child, fulfilling all the dreams they, themselves, couldn't…

Edgar looked around helplessly, unable to join any conversation. He was so nervous he pulled his scarf up high, wishing he could hide completely inside it. Luckily, at that very moment, his father squeezed through the crowd and patted his shoulder: "What do you want to be when you grow up, Edgar?"

Encouraged by his father's gaze, Edgar said softly:
"I… I just want to be Edgar."
派送任务结束后的一天，哈索尔照例驾驶机车，从路边飞驰而去，也许是最近看了太多番剧:
One day after finishing her delivery quests, Hathor was riding her motorcycle as usual, speeding away down the road. Perhaps because she'd been watching too much anime lately, the massive billboard advertisement for "Gen Z" unusually caught Hathor's attention. The limited venue merchandise shown in the promotional image was a term Hathor had been hearing frequently recently, and it looked familiar. The items could only be purchased through limited offline channels, like exclusive conventions, shops, or cafes. As it happened, there was a shop nearby that Haniel had been talking about for ages, and somehow, Hathor felt like trying her luck.
The phrase "trying her luck" shouldn't appear in the vocabulary of someone accustomed to precision operations. Since getting into anime culture, Hathor had gradually begun accepting things in life that carried "randomness": the randomness of gacha pulls, daily fragmented discussions about new anime with her two fellow fans, the randomness of new terms popping up unexpectedly, the "pseudo-randomness" of whether limited venue merchandise could be obtained, and so on…
Today also brought a random event: the spontaneous decision to detour to a limited merchandise shop after finishing deliveries. Next she would "try her luck" on limited goods, and then give an unexpected gift to the two little owls… Hathor habitually kept herself wound tight, perhaps due to muscle memory from early high-intensity deliveries, or the professional discipline of strictly following plans, plus the careful caution she'd always maintained toward her Esper after losing control.
But since she'd begun learning about "modern youngster life" from those two, something called "randomness" had started taking root in her body. Like noticing the billboard advertisement today, like suddenly detouring to a merchandise shop, like putting a gift that wasn't on her quest list into her pouch. She had never so clearly realized that she had been wound too tight for too long, so long that she'd forgotten she actually lived in a city full of human warmth and life.
有关异象管理局不可不知的冷知识其一：管理局休息室的沙发上，会固定长出一只安魂曲。:
Bureau of Anomaly Control Fun Fact #1: A Lacrimosa will regularly spawn on the break room couch.
Other common Lacrimosa spawn points include sun-warmed rooftops, quiet and rarely-visited stairwells, or the inside of a creepy-looking coffin that actually has soft, fluffy padding inside…
There are 24 hours in a day, so sleeping for only 20 hours isn't that much, right?

As ETD-4's adorable little ace, Lacrimosa may not be good at socializing, but her popularity remains sky-high. While her complaint letters are directly proportional to her property damage rate, the thank-you letters and fan mail she receives are equally staggering.
Team relationships? Harmonious. Even when having lunch at Clicky Fast Food, when all the ketchup gets hogged and everyone has to dip their french fries in ice cream instead… it's no big deal.

Perhaps because she's too innocent and pure, Lacrimosa has a unique "eye for discovering beauty."
This manifests as: accidentally bumping into street signs hard enough to hurt her forehead, or taking exhausting routes that take forever to walk despite being quickly reachable by car. In these moments, Lacrimosa reaches the conclusion: Street signs, cars, powerful! Lacrimosa, must learn!
"Actually, controlling Esper Abilities and creating all sorts of complex shapes out of thin air is actually much harder than people imagine. Lacrimosa has put in a lot of effort where no one can see!" —assessment from ETD reserve training staff currently in casts.

What, Lacrimosa's missing again? Did she get lost? Where did she fall asleep this time? Or was she distracted by a roadside tomato jelly vending machine? Well, no worries. Trust that she's still a reliable ETD team member. When the team really needs Lacrimosa, she'll definitely come running.
…Though it'll probably be at the cost of glass doors shattered all along the way.

人与异象是无法互相理解的。或者说，一个人无法真正理解一个异象的感受。\n一群百无:
Humans and Anomalies can't ever truly understand each other's feelings. Or rather, a human can never really understand an Anomaly.
A group of bored children came across a lone Fluffy in the grass. The kid leading the group got a bright idea: he wanted to see what the Fluffy looked like after it transformed, and the others quickly agreed. Treating it like a toy, their poking and teasing gradually transformed into bullying. There is a natural divide between humans and Anomalies; therefore, it is only natural for children not to empathize with an Anomaly. But Linko stood there in silence, unsure how to speak up. Little by little, she began to pick up Fluffy's frequency as it shifted from hurt and confusion into anger.
"St… stop! It's… really sad right now, and if you guys keep going… it'll be dangerous…"
For the first time in her life, Linko shouted at her "friends."
But what came next, whether it was the frequency she felt or the voices she heard, crushed her hopes.
"It's just an Anomaly. Why are you trying so hard to play the saint…?"
"You care so much about what it feels like, but you don't care about how we feel?"
"What a buzzkill freak…"
More than hurt, what filled Linko's heart was disappointment. She and the Fluffy stayed in that grassy field, silent for a long, long time.
Do people boxed in by common sense or prejudice really understand each other? Can they even understand each other at all? Maybe "fitting in" itself is just an illusion; people imprisoned by judgment can never truly understand one another, and all efforts to fit in will only end in a futile tug-of-war.
"We all live in our own frequencies, sending signals into the universe that go unanswered."
That night, Linko wrote in her diary.
Humans can't understand each other either. One person can never really understand how another feels.
Like stars in the night sky, like islands in the sea, gazing at one another across an abyss…
Linko no longer wanted friends.
退行：队友角色由小羊莫尔甫斯/伊刻洛斯/方塔苏斯代为战斗的状态。该状态下的角色无:
Regression: A state where allied characters are replaced in battle by the lambs Morpheus, Icelos, or Phantasos. Characters in this state are invincible, inherit Iroi's stats, and attack automatically. Characters in this state cannot use Revive Items.
Each lamb has 3 attack methods:
Morpheus
Sweet Dreams: Fires an anesthetic needle at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Deep Slumber: Fires multiple anesthetic needles at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Support Skill: Fires a powerful anesthetic bomb at the target, dealing AoE DMG on hit and triggering the Esper Cycle effect of the corresponding character's attribute. Press Morpheus's avatar to cast. Consumes Iroi's Cycle Energy. Counts as Support Skill DMG.

Icelos
Little Prick: Strikes the target with a syringe slash, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Double Dose: Strikes the target with a whirling syringe dance, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Support Skill: Launches a syringe-blast attack at the target, dealing AoE DMG on hit and triggering the Esper Cycle effect of the corresponding character's attribute. Press Icelos's avatar to cast. Consumes Iroi's Cycle Energy. Counts as Support Skill DMG.

Phantasos
Lullaby Time: Plays a burst of sound waves at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Off-Key: Plays a beautiful melody at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Support Skill: Performs a flock concert at the target, dealing AoE DMG on hit and triggering the Esper Cycle effect of the corresponding character's attribute. Press Phantasos's avatar to cast. Consumes Iroi's Cycle Energy. Counts as Support Skill DMG.
小吱有写日记的习惯，在拥有第一本日记本之后，这个习惯就没有断过。她要把值得记录的:
Chiz keeps a diary. She hasn't stopped writing since receiving her first journal. She writes down everything worth remembering, so that when she sees her family again someday, she can tell them everything. Then, she'll finally say the words she's been preparing for so long: "Yes, I've been doing well out here."
But her diary isn't just words: there are rice ball wrapper labels, flower petals that landed on her shoulder, and stickers from coworkers. They're all proof that she's doing well. Chiz feels that only by recording things this way can she truly feel like she's not just stumbling through a pleasant dream.
At first, Chiz's diary entries were very short.
"M: XX, D: XX. Food was good."
"M: XX, D: XX. Clothes were pretty."
"M: XX, D: XX. Flowers smelled nice."
She didn't know what else to write, so she just honestly recorded how she felt. Once, a friend found out and suggested, "If you don't know what to write, why not try drawing?" But Chiz didn't think her drawings were all that good, either. She was still troubled.
One day, Chiz ate a delicious candy. She couldn't bear to throw away even the crinkled wrapper, so she put it in her diary. The candy was delicious, and her problem was solved. She's continued to this day.
"Ahhh, how is it this late already? I have work tomorrow!"
Chiz hurriedly closes her diary. Her entries have been longer and longer, lately. There's more and more worth recording. That tasty milk tea has to be written down. Getting praised by her manager has to be written down. The first sunny day of spring, the first sunny day of summer, the first sunny day of fall, and the first snowfall of winter all have to be properly recorded. Chiz doesn't like rainy days. She only likes sunny days, because on rainy days, food is hard to find.
But Chiz really likes snowy days in Hethereau. Snow is clean and white.

残虹能记起姐姐是何时变了的，也能记起那时的自己是多么信任她，多么松懈和愚蠢。\n:
Zankou could recall when her sister changed, and how trusting, careless, and foolish she had been before.
It was at one of Inanna's auction events. Daffodill, who was in charge of security, had acted out of turn and returned after a brief disappearance looking a bit haggard. She covered her left eye and brushed the whole incident off, referring to it as an "accident." Seeing her sister's face wounded to such an extent caused Zankou to fly into a rage, so much so that in the next few missions, her methods were far more brutal than usual. For months after, Daffodill wore an eye patch. To comfort her sister, Zankou even had one made for herself—completely useless, of course—and when she took it out to show off, her sister could only respond with a startled laugh.
Zankou never once wondered what exactly that eye patch of Daffodill's was hiding.
On one rainy night, she witnessed Inanna lying in a pool of blood, and Daffodill—the Esper who had taken off her eye patch and was holding a blade. Mother's blood had stained her sister's collar a glaring crimson. And that flame… that pure white flame was entirely extinguished. It had become something utterly unlike anything before, unlike anyone else—a color of sublime purity Zankou had never perceived in her life.
Zankou attempted to make sense of the chaos before her. Too many questions crashed together in her mind. She didn't understand why her sister had betrayed them, didn't understand where her sister's Esper Ability had come from, and didn't understand what that odd flame even meant. As for Daffodill… she merely stood there, unmoving, like a child frozen in fear, strangled by shame.
Her sister fled in silence, that streak of light vanishing beyond the hedges of the Scarlet Letter Garden.
Zankou struggled to call out for her, their mother still lying off to the wayside, forgotten in a pool of blood. All Zankou's thoughts—and her gaze—incessantly followed her sister's departing figure. An unknown amount of time had passed before she finally uttered a few words, those same words she had said to her sister countless times before:
"What a beautiful color…"
海月的经历可谓是丰富多彩：参加过合唱团，组建过乐队，当过异象猎人，如今成为一名兢:
Aurelia's life has been anything but boring: she sang in a choir, started a band, worked as an Anomaly Hunter, and now she's a diligent salarywoman. With a resume that impressive, some might consider her life a bit too "maxed out" for someone her age—at least, that's what the regulars on Tamamochi Street often gossip to each other. 

Of course, her colorful background never prevented her from diving headfirst into whatever job she takes on. These days, as the street manager of Tamamochi Street, Aurelia can easily name every resident and recall their likes and dislikes—no matter how old or young. She's always the first to offer a helping hand to solve whatever daily problems the residents run into. Her dedication to her job often makes people wonder: just how much does the City Hall pay her? 

After work, Aurelia will sometimes be spotted wandering the streets alone. If you were to walk up and talk to her, nine times out of ten you'll find she's completely lost (and she'll be very grateful to any good samaritan that'd point her in the right direction)… Sometimes, though, Aurelia will pretend to know where she's going, though no one truly believes her. In the end, everyone on Tamamochi Street is Aurelia's friend. However, it seems that there isn't anyone who genuinely understands her.

As for the places she wishes to go but, for some reason or another, can't, and the words she wants to say but swallows them down every time… maybe only someone who stays by her side for a long, long time will ever be allowed to know. Then again, everyone keeps a few secrets locked away in their heart, right? Today, Aurelia is once again smiling, her head held high as she rides her beloved jellyfish down the street, cheerfully greeting everyone she meets. This is the life she chose, no matter what.

阿德勒先生，全名阿洛伊斯·V·阿德勒，不过至今没有人会连名带姓的直呼这位看起来就:
Adler, full name Alois V. Adler. Although no one has ever called this clearly respectable butler by his full name. At Eibon, being a butler is an incredibly difficult job. Daily duties include but are not limited to: preparing seven completely different breakfasts and getting picky kids to eat their vegetables, keeping track of and restocking the store's alcohol and hangover remedy supplies, damage control plans for unavoidable losses during commissions, maintaining a positive attitude when facing the shop's account balance…
All in all, any one is lucky to have a butler like him.

Gold medal swordsman, ten-ring archery certificate, advanced tea ceremony instructor, and Bridge Crossings Paper Plane Competition champion. She got any toy she wanted right away, and even if she was picky about her food or stayed up too late, she never got punished. Wasn't that enough? Compared to her classmates whose parents were strict or distant, she already had so much. She shouldn't be greedy for more.

Soon enough, the moon climbed high into the sky, and the hands of the clock continued to tick inch by inch.
Eventually, Aurelia gave up. She lit the candle that was nearly sinking into the buttercream, sang "Happy Birthday" to herself, and then gently blew it out. For an instant, the room flared with a brilliant, bright glow before slipping back into darkness.

"Just once would be enough," She thought. I wish Mom and Dad could come home.

红字的花园中养育着许多花朵，慈爱的伊南娜呵护着她们，为她们降下甘露，修剪枝条。其:
The Scarlet Letter Garden nurtured many flowers. The loving Inanna tended to them, raining down sweet dew and pruning their branches. The flowers that pleased her most were even granted new names—"Red Nightshade" was one of the many.
Yet, Zankou knew that Mother did not love her flowers; she simply enjoyed standing at the center of the garden and admiring her hard work.
Within the Scarlet Letter's estate walls, Inanna no longer needed to hide her true nature. The generous, sentimental philanthropist was merely a public performance. In the confines of her heart, there was only a businesswoman's austere coldness and greed, along with the arrogance that developed unceasingly once she had entered "high society". Like a towering crimson spire, she cast a chilling shadow, looming endlessly over her Garden.
She always mixed rewards with punishment when dealing with her daughters. Zankou was subjected to the harshest training. Zankou didn't care; her time in the dungeon had long since numbed her to pain. Even after enduring such torment at the hands of Mother, Zankou still dedicated complete loyalty to her, and carried out every task she was given. As she watched her other sisters have their emotions and fates toyed with, however, Zankou found that she, too, could find a little amusement in the Garden.
The Eye of Delusion could perceive emotions—and taste them, too. The rotten sweetness of fear, the bitterness of despair, and the sharp bite of hatred… her fellow flowers' feelings became nourishment for Zankou… And Zankou came to fully understand Mother's hobby.
Her aberrant eye was always on the prowl for vivid colors, as if admiring a field for its beautiful blooms, only to pluck the finest flowers. Whenever a lovely sobbing rang out through the estate at night, and the tiny glows of the soul twinkled, Zankou would gladly bring comfort to that fragile bud, then later control it, toy with it, to then ultimately cast it aside. Under her words and gaze, those unsettled little buds bloomed.
Such pleasure never lasted long. The girls' minds were rapidly frayed from gazing into the Eye of Delusion, becoming husks at Zankou's mercy, and the color of their souls faded, withering and unwatered.
It never mattered, though. The Scarlet Letter's Garden was vast; even if one blossom withered, there would always be another waiting to sprout.

"Mr. Adler, are you cleaning the storage room again?"
"Yes."
As the young man holding cleaning supplies stepped aside, the neatly dressed maid quietly thanked him, kindly reminding him to watch his steps, then hurried off. This estate housed too many people like him, so even this small act of kindness felt precious. The blind young man stood quietly at the storage room entrance until the maid's footsteps faded, then entered the room, feeling his way around while wiping dust with a soft cloth. The other servants disliked cleaning here since it was such tedious work, but Adler didn't mind. Cleaning was actually quite easy work for him—no need to talk to anyone, and the quiet environment made him feel especially relaxed. Though his blindness meant he often needed more time, fortunately this storage room didn't contain anything too fragile, so he just needed to be careful. Adler treasured this hard-won job.
The artifacts silently watched the busy young man. He didn't favor any particular piece, cleaning each one thoroughly, but whenever he wiped down that suit of armor hanging high above, he would always clean it with extra care. Adler had heard stories about this armor. It was called "Enlightenment,"and people told tales of the armor, with its great power and invincible previous owners. Those stories burned in his thin chest. Perhaps he too might someday… Whenever he thought this, Adler would calmly polish each scale even cleaner.
The peaceful days continued until one snowy night, when the long-silent armor began glowing softly. Deer-like creatures called "Sunyas" emerged from Enlightenment, treading on falling snowflakes as they gathered around the sleeping young man.
"New… master?"
"I like him!"
"Familiar scent."
"…Mhm."
"In this old one's opinion…"
Their chatter didn't wake the sleeping person; they wanted to let his dream last a little longer—they would tell the young man about the good news when the snow cleared and the sun shone bright the next day.

"F-for me?"

I heard everyone has a dream like this while they're still in the womb. You watch yourself crawl from the water onto land, slowly evolving into a human, and finally wake up naturally, right as you're being born.
But in that dream, Iroi wasn't born as a primate. Instead, she was sent on a different evolutionary path, becoming one of the Caprinae.
This should never have happened, and her human nature forced her to wake up from that dream. And so, she woke up in her mother's womb way too early.

She was taken away as her world opened up.
After living in the womb, the real world overflowed with light and empty space. It was terrifying. Her mind was shocked, and she no longer wanted to live. As a result, Iroi lost consciousness, and her body shut down. That's the beginning of her sicknesses.

When she was hungry or was in pain, she voiced her needs to attract attention.

Just saying something out loud isn't always enough to make people believe it, so she learned all the right expressions.
Knowing what to say, to whom, and in what context, that's something she also had to pick up, however slowly…

Having grown up this way, how exactly is she any different from any authentic human being?

—Humans usually do not question whether they are humans or not. She does. That's about it.

Chiz is terrified of loud noises. She's been afraid of thunder since she was little, but it got so much worse after she became an Esper. This is the price she pays for her powers. The sound of popcorn machines, fireworks going off, even karaoke—any overly-noisy environment makes her heart race. Only her soundproof home soothes her. Because of this, Chiz never attends gatherings.
"Chiz, want to grab dinner together this weekend?"
Mayu was inviting her again. Chiz did want to go. She was so grateful to Mayu, the first person to show her kindness after she joined Pink Paws Bank. And it wasn't just Mayu; there was Haruna, Grace… All her coworkers were wonderful people. Chiz had always wanted to treat them to a meal and properly express her thanks. But someone like her…
"I should probably…"
"How about coming to my place? I'll show you my cooking. Come on, Chiz, come on."
If it was at someone's home, it probably wouldn't be too loud…
Chiz finally accepted. She stayed up all night reading posts on Bagel to learn how to be a polite houseguest. If she never got another chance, she had to make this one count.
"Welcome! You didn't have to bring anything!"
"Chiz's here? Come in, come in!"
"Um… H-Hello, everyone…"
The house was warm. There was the smell of home cooking and the chatter of coworkers. So this is what a gathering was like. How nice. Just as Chiz was secretly feeling happy, Grace handed her a box.
"F-for me?"
"Of course! Open it, quick." Haruna leaned in close to Chiz, urging her to open it.
Chiz untied the ribbon. Inside the box was a pair of noise-canceling earplugs. They were beautiful. And pink.
"Pretty, right? We all picked them out together."
"Other than being cute, they're almost completely useless. The noise-canceling is extremely average."
"But they're perfect for our Chiz, right?"
Yes, the noise-canceling was perfectly average… Just enough for Chiz to hear the sound of fireworks blooming in the sky without being so scared that she had to cover her ears and run away.

Skia's name had once been praised by his old colleagues as having "quite the martial artist's spirit." Skia didn't care much for the supposed depth of his name. But he found quiet satisfaction in the act of writing it—each letter placed with purpose, each curve and line falling into place. It was neat, orderly, and well arranged. Just the way he liked.
However, whenever he signed his name with too much force, that scene would always reappear in his mind… That day when he signed his employment contract at his ex-company.
For that job, he completely embraced all the workplace etiquette his colleagues believed in as "standard practice," never questioning any of it. This included things like specialized signature training to leave clients with an elite impression.
It made perfect sense, really—if all it took to preserve one's dignity was to follow a visible, rigid set of rules, then the cost was laughably low for the rewards.

As for his current signature… the overall form remained rigorous, but a closer look revealed slightly hurried connecting strokes.
Had he stopped caring about these surface details? Had taking too much time off made him sloppy? Or perhaps it was the pressure from too many emergency missions piling up with all the cleanup…

Things weren't done the way he wanted. He felt he was the only one willing to maintain the system. Well… there was nothing he could do about that.
Despite that, he gradually got used to working at the BAC. And… how should he put it? He didn't mind the sincere jokes of his teammates.

On the other hand, there was a new cafeteria lady at the Bureau who was particularly enthusiastic about Skia.
When serving him food, though Skia hadn't said anything, she would ladle several extra bone-in ribs, then casually speak to another female staff member about how her son also likes chewing on those ribs.
The other woman lowered her voice, sounding embarrassed. "He… he's not an Oddity! He's the lieutenant from ETD-4!"
Skia quietly stared at the perfectly balanced, almost strict meal composition, topped with those extra bone-in ribs… then picked up his tray and walked away. In the end, he never asked about the "breed" of the lady's son.

Daffodill owns many eyepatches. Though she wears them less now, she still keeps up her collecting habit. Nobody can tell the difference between those eyepatches, but she firmly believes in her taste. Leather ones, patterned ones, ones with especially neat stitching… she carefully sorts them by category and places them in her small collection box.

Daffodill was not born with poor vision; rather, it was the price of her Esper Ability. At nineteen, cruel truth burst into her eyes like a kaleidoscope, and since then she could see through anomalies to perceive layers of essence across time and space. Sometimes, glimpsing the truth is not a good thing. She learned about her parents' cause of death, about her own wishful emotional attachments, about needing and being needed… and lost the faith she had relied on for survival. The red-cloaked hero in the picture book silently turned her blade toward Mother, toward that hateful, beating heart that had once falsely given her warmth. If the goddess of vengeance wanted to punish her for this… then so be it.

Daff longed for a happy, beautiful place, and so accidentally embarked on a journey full of metaphors.
So then, what about the ending of the story?
Her life until now was one monopolized by lies. It was a life in which no one needed her… there was no point in continuing. That was what Daffodill had been thinking when she met that slightly tipsy woman. The woman talked about a daffodil growing in the center of the lake, proud and aloof, seemingly impossible for anyone to pick. She naturally needed that flower too, but would not pick it.
A strange woman and a strange flower. What reason did that daffodil have for growing alone there? It must depend on something. Surely it grew that way because it was rooted in others' need for it. When the wind rose, Daffodill heard a different sound of rustling leaves than before.

Why not follow the woman and seek answers in the life ahead?

Anomaly Story
T-1881 (Ob) Scarlet Phantom is an Anomaly that occasionally appears at performance venues, such as concert halls, theaters, cinemas, and so on. It often manifests as black-and-white evening wear, with men's and women's outfits always appearing in pairs. The pairs of clothing will float in midair and engage in ballroom or other styles of dancing. Because Scarlet Phantom is drawn to ostentatious performances and is subsequently nullified following their ending, this Anomaly is typically considered harmless. However, disrupting a performance, or inhibiting Scarlet Phantom's dance, will trigger an aggressive response from the Anomaly. When attacking, what were once moves dedicated to dancing transform into moves for combat. For experienced Anomaly Hunters, Scarlet Phantom poses little to no threat. However, Scarlet Phantoms are known to appear in groups, thereby greatly increasing their danger to the public.
Some performers regard the appearance of Scarlet Phantoms as a sign of a spectacular performance. This belief isn't entirely unfounded, considering that Scarlet Phantoms have distinct tastes. However, it is always ideal to remain conscious of their threat levels, and notify the Bureau of any Anomaly appearances.

Characteristics
- Drawn to grand performances, they attack anyone who tries to hinder their performance.
- Recent reports indicate that when an object, imbued with intense human obsession, is present in the environment, the underlying nullification rules are severely disrupted, and a corresponding performance stage is constructed according to said obsession.

Anomaly Nexus
When the performance that attracts them ends, or when their dance steps are disrupted by an external force.
When Scarlet Phantoms are in a state where their underlying nullification logic has been disrupted, active intervention in the stage they have constructed is required, and the core entity within the area must be defeated to force the performance to conclude.

Risk Assessment
Low hazard. When they appear in groups, the hazard level may rise to moderate.

Containment Status
A small number are contained at Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
The Containment Units must provide enough space for dancing. Since this Anomaly is naturally nullified when the performance ends, the Containment Units should continuously play classic performances that have previously attracted Scarlet Phantoms on a large screen, and the playback list should be updated according to appearance records.

With zero remorse for his antics, Baicang swoops in to gleefully like and save every comment.

Rumors about Squad 4's captain are mixed.
For instance, "Watch out for that long silver-white braid, for it's the Reaper's banner." "He seems to like hiding behind his team members and playing weak, but he's actually analyzing his opponents' strength and countermeasures." "He's reliable when it counts, very capable, and doesn't abuse his power." "He loves all kinds of pasta, especially Italian, but when he cooks it himself he breaks the noodles in half before putting them in the pot (absolutely tasteless)." All these rumors are basically true, confirmed with love from his closest team members.

Beyond that, things lurk in his past that they cannot see.

From an unwanted branch family child to voluntarily entering the main house for Esper Ability development, the young man gradually slipped toward what he thought was a beautiful "abyss." He learned early the weight of life: Light as a feather. Something he could blow away just by speaking. For a long time he stopped saying anything at all, perhaps to atone, perhaps simply from fear. He was like a lone young leaf that had lost its way, spinning as it fell, until finally caught by someone important… that was when he found his home.

Are words curses or prayers? He can easily extinguish life, yet cannot preserve anything. Thus, he can only keep moving forward.
From summer to winter, from spring to fall, the veins of fall leaves turn yellow, still clinging to the branches before finally falling.
In the system of the Five Colors, white is associated with Gui Cang and the season of autumn, giving rise to the name White Cang or Baicang.
「就在此处……艺术的幽灵。」\r\n\r\n【异象故事】\r\nT-1881[O:
"A relic of the past."

Anomaly Story
T-1881 (Ob) Scarlet Phantom is an Anomaly that occasionally appears at performance venues, such as concert halls, theaters, cinemas, and so on. It often manifests as black-and-white evening wear, with men's and women's outfits always appearing in pairs. The pairs of clothing will float in midair and engage in ballroom or other styles of dancing. Because Scarlet Phantom is drawn to ostentatious performances and is subsequently nullified following their ending, this Anomaly is typically considered harmless. However, disrupting a performance, or inhibiting Scarlet Phantom's dance, will trigger an aggressive response from the Anomaly. When attacking, what were once moves dedicated to dancing transform into moves for combat. For experienced Anomaly Hunters, Scarlet Phantom poses little to no threat. However, Scarlet Phantoms are known to appear in groups, thereby greatly increasing their danger to the public.
Some performers regard the appearance of Scarlet Phantoms as a sign of a spectacular performance. This belief isn't entirely unfounded, considering that Scarlet Phantoms have distinct tastes. However, it is always ideal to remain conscious of their threat levels, and notify the Bureau of any Anomaly appearances.

Characteristics
- Drawn to grand performances, they attack anyone who tries to hinder their performance.
- Recent reports indicate that when an object, imbued with intense human obsession, is present in the environment, the underlying nullification rules are severely disrupted, and a corresponding performance stage is constructed according to said obsession.

Anomaly Nexus
When the performance that attracts them ends, or when their dance steps are disrupted by an external force.
When Scarlet Phantoms are in a state where their underlying nullification logic has been disrupted, active intervention in the stage they have constructed is required, and the core entity within the area must be defeated to force the performance to conclude.

Risk Assessment
Low hazard. When they appear in groups, the hazard level may rise to moderate.

Containment Status
A small number are contained at Celaeno Compound.

Containment Measures
The Containment Units must provide enough space for dancing. Since this Anomaly is naturally nullified when the performance ends, the Containment Units should continuously play classic performances that have previously attracted Scarlet Phantoms on a large screen, and the playback list should be updated according to appearance records.
在数字支付如此普遍的时代，小吱仍然坚持着把每个月的工资从银行中取出来，兑换成现金:
In an age when digital payments are everywhere, Chiichan still insists on withdrawing her salary from the bank each month, exchanging it for cash, and dividing it into a thin stack and a thick stack. She picks up the thin stack and counts it carefully. Once, twice, three times. Then she takes a few bills from it and adds them to the thick stack before tucking it all into a sturdy envelope.
"This address…" she says. "We don't have direct delivery there." The post office clerk looks at the destination with some difficulty.
"Th-That's okay."
"There's a good chance it could get lost with that many transfers, you know?"
"…Yes, I know."
Chiichan hands the envelope to the clerk. The envelope is stamped; she receives a mailing receipt in return. Walking home with the receipt, a map slowly unfolds in her mind. Chiichan has looked at many maps. On them, the place where she was born is just a tiny dot. If she left from Hethereau, she would have to take a very, very long boat ride to reach a new city, then transfer to a train and ride for a very, very long time to yet another city… If she chose to fly partway, she would have to take a very, very long bus ride… But even once she's figured out the route home, she has to think about the travel costs, and the savings needed so her family could live happily together without ever having to hunt Apocha again. She calculates how much she can save each month, how long it will take… By the time she's done with all the calculations, she's arrived.
Chiichan stands in front of the mailbox by her door, breathing deeply. Whenever she moves somewhere new, the first thing she does is send her new address back home. Then she waits. Maybe today will bring a letter…
"Knock knock." Chiichan taps lightly on the mailbox. "Knock knock." Two more taps.
This is a secret code between the siblings: it means "I found you." When they couldn't speak, they would answer each other with soft knocks instead.
Chiichan opens the mailbox. Inside is nothing but dust. So it is, every month.
Chiichan closes the mailbox and goes home with another mailing receipt. There are a dozen identical ones in her bedside drawer. So it is, every month.
Chiichan doesn't know when she will receive a letter from home. Maybe tomorrow. Maybe next month. Maybe never.
残虹和达芙蒂尔曾经是「红字」最锋利的两把刀。她们共同浸染的罪恶，与彼此心底的空洞:
Zankou and Daffodill were once Scarlet Letter's sharpest daggers. The sins that stained them were as dark as the hollowness in their heart.
Trial after trial, mission after mission, they enacted Mother's bidding. Zankou didn't care for her life as a blade; rather, she only desired to watch Daffodill.
As an assassin, she knew of every obstacle Mother needed removed. But as a person, she knew only Daffodill
Daffodill always stood before the mirror after finishing a mission, contemplating in silence as she bandaged her wounds. And every time, Zankou would quietly savor that weary, melancholic back—beautiful even when riddled with scars—and, as always, use her Esper Ability and a tender hug to dispel her sister's doubts.
Finally, those doubts bore fruit.
On one mission, when it was time to bring the blade down on a target, Daffodill listened to the target's pleas for mercy—and stilled her hand. Zankou witnessed her hand trembling, yet also noticed the bloodthirstiness shrouded in those cries for mercy. At that moment, a treacherous idea took root in her mind.
In the blink of an eye, the cold gleam of a hidden weapon flashed toward her sister. Zankou deliberately stepped in front of the blade, taking the blow. In this moment, Zankou also struck back against the assailant, killing them.
Blood poured from her wound—pain she would willingly endure. Breathing hard, Zankou gazed upwards. She saw Daffodill's trembling hand loosen around the knife, and heard hurried footsteps and an apology laden with fright.
"At last, you've become as weak as they are."
Zankou watched, enraptured by the violently wavering flame before her.
She had imagined it countless times: no longer restraining her Esper Ability, Zankou using her eyes to see through everything, then pulling her into an illusion meant only for the two of them. Twisting her likes and dislikes, manipulating her memories—until, before she could completely devolve into a sentimental, uninteresting commoner, she would become Zankou's plaything.
However, in those final moments, Zankou had relented.
Even softened and shaken, that white flame still fascinated her. She no longer desired to snuff it out.

「时间行进到第六百年。暴雨连绵四十个昼夜，洪水滔天，把世上的崎岖都填作平原。」\:
"In the 600th year, rain fell for forty days and forty nights. Waters rose upon the face of the earth, swallowing every hill and filling every valley until all was made plain."
…
…
He said his name was "Plain," but that didn't sound like a real name. He's a mysterious guy. It's like he knows everything, but I've never seen him in a fight. He likes to claim that he's omniscient and omnipotent, and although he's never been wrong… I just can't help but find him annoying.
Our boat is built. Plain said we needed to give it a name and proposed to call it "the Boulder." Hello??? Wouldn't a boulder sink in the sea? What an unlucky name! The others, however, seemed to like the name, especially that crazy woman with the vines, who said she'll write a heroic epic from the adventures of the Boulder. Is she serious? Plain even gave her his approval, saying that we'll all become heroes. Where did thIs confidence come from?
…
We're actually getting more and more commissions and we're getting more famous. Everyone thinks we're heroes.
Plain has yet to be wrong. I do respect that. By the way, the boat is operational, and we can now call him "Captain." I don't like to call him "Plain," so that's a win for me. Anyway, if he truly knew about everything, why would he ever be sent on that smuggler's ship in the first place?
…
There've been sightings of a monster that resembles an octopus. Many people got hurt. We need to take it down. The captain hesitated for a long time before deciding to accept the commission. I'm not sure what's on his mind. I just know that it has to be us.
During our strategic meeting, the captain kept telling Shorty to not fly too high. It's not like she can fly that high, right?
…
It's over. We won. Shorty died. I can't believe the crazy woman with vines drank too much and didn't show up. This was such an important fight… Had she been there, Shorty might have survived. But thoughts like this won't help…
…
We have enough supplies to go back, but some don't want to leave. They want to be "heroes" here… I get it. We don't know what kind of dangers lies ahead on our way back… but still, I need to return.
I must return.
…
…
Now I realize, my parents knew it was a smuggler's ship.
I don't have to go back now… Ghroth Island is not that bad anyway.

对于未知之物，人类总是有着相似的好奇与傲慢。从敬畏到恐惧，从试探到染指，直到名为:
When it comes to the unknown, human beings have always shared the same curiosity and arrogance. From awe to fear, from scrutinizing to touching, until the spark of "conquest" fully ignited the fuse of greed… such was the attitude some held toward the existence known as "Espers".
Cults, circles, private research institutes, secret societies… those driven by greed and pride gathered like hyenas, desperate for a morsel of flesh. They would pay any price, ignore every restriction and taboo, and thirst for the miracles an Esper Ability could bring… or perhaps, for the ability itself.
On a remote island, there was a secret society deemed "Eyepecker." Its members believed in a heresy: Esper Abilities were a gift from a mysterious unknown, and that gift would bless the fortunate ones born with special "eyes". They went about collecting those who were described as such, regarding them as "vessels" for the awakening of Esper Abilities, imprisoning them in dark, dank dungeons and burning their eyes every day with a searing mixture. They firmly believed this would awaken abilities—and that by transplanting those eyes into themselves, they could seize that power for their own.
Zankou's earliest memory began in that cruel jail.
The girl had a pair of gem-like eyes. She could not understand why, her vision deprived of color, she could only see a gray-white blur. What she understood even less was how far a human's greed could push them to do the unspeakable. Ever since Eyepecker had abducted her, the meaning of her existence had been reduced to being completely bound every day, having her eyelids pried open, and trembling as the scalding, acrid, murky liquid dripped onto her eyeballs.
The voracious, intoxicated by their own delusions, carried out their devilish deeds day after day, heedless of its absurdity. Yet, ironically, Zankou really did awaken the Esper Ability dwelling in her eyes under that inhuman torture. When she was brought to the eye-extraction ritual, the society's members were already arguing over who the eyes would belong to, each one revealing the hidden identity they had been concealing all along: the powerful, the wealthy, or some illustrious family… Their voices grew into a raucous uproar, and in the haze of anesthesia, Zankou saw the first color beyond black and white. It was warm and blinding, burning brightly among the embers of countless souls, spraying from wounds opened in slaughter, weaving into a scarlet maelstrom that encircled her…
That day, the Eye of Delusion shrouded the entire island, and the lowlifes who competed with one another instead butchered each other to death, drowning within the hallucination, until no one was left alive.
忙碌了一整天后，哈索尔回到了斯特利，店内传来的叽叽喳喳声多少有些引人注目，老师温:
After a busy day, Hathor returned to Sterry. The chatter and cheer inside was somewhat inviting. The Mentor warmly introduced two new members of Sterry: Haniel and Illica. Hathor didn't have any particular thoughts about their arrival and simply nodded in acknowledgment. Following the Mentor's arrangements was something she was used to. If Hathor were to recall her feelings from meeting with Haniel and Illica, she'd probably say: Very energetic, great couriers.

However, while interacting with them over the following few days, Hathor gradually realized that the relationships between the five of them weren't as smooth as expected. The Mentor and Jenson, who were familiar with her, could sense her true thoughts from her expressions and actions even when she said nothing, and knew she wasn't intentionally cold. The two new members didn't seem to understand, though. Perhaps due to her icy exterior, they always showed some instinctive wariness, completely different from how lively they were when facing the Mentor. Just as Hathor was repeatedly pondering how to explain to them that she simply wasn't good at socializing, a conversation with the Mentor changed everything. She was given a unique commission: spend time with Haniel and Illica, and understand the lives of modern youngsters. This was a task with a clear directive, so she didn't hesitate.

However, when actually facing the two, taking the initiative to speak proved much more difficult than expected. Hathor had mentally rehearsed scenarios for initial conversations many times and had even prepared several backup plans for dealing with awkward silences. So, during a rare chat session, she tentatively asked about their daily hobbies. The following responses completely deviated from her expectations:
"Of course it's watching the greatest manga of this century, 'Gen Z'!"
"Buying merch, going to events, analyzing the lore with fellow fans on Bagel, conventions, live events, and wotagei!"
"Seasonal anime previews, fan arts, weekly new episodes… we never miss a single one!"
Faced with Haniel's enthusiastic string of recommendations, Hathor showed visible confusion: What is wotagei? What is an "anime"?
Just as Hathor was about to interrupt and give her brain some time to process, she caught sight of Illica, who was eagerly waiting with excitement to join the conversation. She fell silent for a moment and held herself back from speaking. If they'd really like to talk about it… then listening for a while longer wouldn't hurt.
在所有的姐妹中，唯有一位，残虹在与之对视时，会克制住自己的异能。\n也唯有这一位:
Among all her sisters, only one made Zankou limit her abilities when they locked eyes.
Her soul was a pure, translucent flame, as clear as the first light of dawn. As if beholding a wondrous sight, she blurted out at their very first meeting…
"What a beautiful color…"
But the white-clad girl named Daffodill didn't understand. She simply obeyed her adoptive mother's orders, walked to the car door, bowed, and reached out to welcome her new little sister.
"Welcome home, little sister."
Zankou reached out toward her, obsession and curiosity gathering in her eyes. Unknowingly, a feral smile nearly surfaced on the girl's face. As if snatching something away, she suddenly clutched that girl's hand tightly, pulling her closer, as if wanting to bathe herself in that hallowed flame…
After that unconventional greeting, they were eventually ordered to become partners, sisters—family.
Zankou knew she and her sister were not the same, but so what? Two complete opposites—conjoined in their fate. In the Scarlet Letter Garden, countless vines would wind around and bind them, till death did them part. They would step into the same mire, share the same flower bed, walk onto the same battlefield, and return to the same grave. They were as close as family could be.
Day after day, she watched Daffodill through her "special" eye. As the first daughter adopted by Inanna, Daffodill was steadfast and immovable, rigid—no matter how harsh the mission, she would always surpass Mother's expectations. When it came to eliminating a target, she was even unfeeling… Yet that very same sister would tenderly heal her wounds after every mission or punishment.
…But later, for some undiscernable reason, Daffodill changed. That decisiveness and indifference became hesitation, along with growing melancholy and confusion. From then on, that white, steady flame would occasionally flutter.
"So she has a side like that too, then."
Zankou continued to observe Daffodill, as though watching a bud begin to blossom. If her sister became weak, before Mother destroyed and discarded her, she would transform her into her most prized possession. With a heavy heart, Zankou looked forward to that day.
母亲没有死于姐姐的暗杀，她醒来，养好伤，仿佛无事发生一般保持着平日里的形象。残虹:
Mother survived Daffodill's attempt on her life. She woke, recovered from her injuries, and maintained her usual image as if nothing had occurred. Zankou was unsurprised. Daffodill had mastered the art of assassination, but someone like Mother was not to be trifled with. She still performed her role as that poised, luxurious philanthropist—as if entirely unphased by Daffodill's betrayal.
Zankou could see the subtle change, however.
In the past, Mother's emotions had always been stable and cold, even going so far as to be utterly arrogant. Following the assassination attempt, though, she became distrustful, constantly carrying the unease often found in those in positions of power…
The scarlet tower in her memory had already collapsed, but Zankou no longer cared about such frivolous things.
Right now, her only desire was to drag that woman who had slipped through her fingers back by the neck…
Mother brought another "Little Sister" back home, eventually. She had begun to favor the children whose vulnerability made her feel powerful in turn—and the girl named Poinsette was one of them. At first, Zankou only considered her another flower among the field. Unexpectedly, though, she discovered an interesting side to the newly introduced bud. Precocious and gifted, that little bud wouldn't let Mother's favoritism or torment transform her into a wilting flower. Instead, she became a resilient weed, seeking any way of escape from Scarlet Letter's garden. Seeing through her act, Zankou became even more curious and took the initiative to entice Mother into promoting Poinsette, so that she would serve at Inanna's side from then on. That little bud, now a weed, noticed Zankou's intentions, and could only obediently play along…
Though the song and dance between the two amused Zankou for a while, it couldn't fill the void left by Daffodill's absence. Zankou never encountered anyone whose soul could compare to hers, and thus her longing grew day by day…
At last, after a long and thorough investigation, she caught wind of Daffodil's trail—a rundown antique shop in Hethereau, a shanty utterly unfit for her.
Fortunately, Inanna's next target was also in Hethereau, so Zankou gladly undertook the mission and went to investigate. Daily, she disguised herself as various passersby, passing by Eibon's door countless times, until she had finally come upon the face she had waited so long to see.
Suppressing a smile, she slipped into a dark alley, pressed a hand to her chest, and felt her heartbeat pounding wildly like a drum.
"This time, you'll never escape from me again, Sister."
